metric: the firm's own percent change against its 2019-2021 average, minus the median change of the drawn firms on no list in the same year

rules.population: firms on no supplied list, geocoded below city level, inside the 160 x 90 km rectangle (the same firms as the M6 rasters)
rules.cell: floor((x - xmin) / size), floor((y - ymin) / size), the top edges folded into the last cell; the 1 km grid coincides with M5's Moscow city_1km grid shifted 35 columns east
rules.colour: a cell carries the class of its filers' median revenue change when it has 20 or more filers with a value; otherwise it is an outline only
rules.absence: statements absent (baseline firms without a statement) are counted per cell (nfb) but not mapped at the city and region scales; the sequence shows absence only at the downtown scale

notes: Descriptive: the metric is each firm's own revenue path, aggregated by cell; no spatial or proximity effect is estimated.
